name: DOE Amended Record of Decision for Direct-Feed High-Level Waste
known_limitations: The October 2025 record selects continued Direct-Feed High-Level Waste implementation and additional storage capacity. It is a decision record but not the GAO-requested pause, independent optimization, mission-need reset, safety-prerequisite package, or GAO acceptance.
